answer_2.quote: To evaluate CAIR 's rankings and the graph theory measure's quality, we used the following metrics: Total ranking success (TRS). The percentage of queries for which all the agents' rankings were identical to the ground truth. Precision@3/@2/@1 (P@3, P@2, P@1). The percentage of queries in which the group of the top three/two/one agents contains the same agents as the ground truth. 1 -Normalized Spearman's Footrule Distance (1-SFD).

answer_4.quote: We then performed human verification on these cases to determine which ranking more closely aligns with human preferences regarding agent importance. Verification was carried out independently by two researchers on the team.
